title: Farmhouse
description: A cosy two-storey farmhouse (12 x 9 m footprint incl. eaves and porch), ridge along x: cream walls on a concrete plinth with white corner boards and a band between the floors, white-framed sash windows (red shutters on the front), attic windows in the gables, a dark pitched roof with white fascia and a brick chimney, and a covered front porch facing +Z with steps, posts, a rail and a red front door. Static scenery, no interior.
checks: FRONT tile: a covered porch across the middle of the front with steps up to a red door, two floors of windows with red shutters
3/4 tile: cream walls, a dark two-sided roof with the ridge running left-right, a brick chimney poking up through the roof near one end
LEFT tile: a gable end with windows on both floors and an attic window, the porch roof sloping down at the front end
BACK tile: plain back wall with two rows of windows, no porch
TOP tile: the roof covers the house, the porch roof sticks out at the front, the chimney is visible
